$comment: Life areas (report part V). Career and family are read from the Bhagyank, money, love and health from the Mulank. The child field is the parents' wording. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

life.career.1.text: Your path points to leadership and work where you set the direction. Founding a business, running a team or holding a post with real authority suits you far better than a role where others decide every step. Government, administration, management and any field where you can put your name to the result all fit. Expect to rise fastest when you take responsibility early and stand by your decisions.
life.career.1.child: Your child learns best when given responsibility and a real choice. Put them in charge of small projects, a class role or a team captaincy, and confidence grows quickly. Praise effort and independence rather than obedience alone. Subjects with clear goals and visible results hold their attention best.

life.career.2.text: Your path points to work with people and care: counselling, teaching, nursing, hospitality, diplomacy, design and any role that needs tact. You do best as the trusted partner or adviser rather than the lone face in front. Partnerships and steady teams bring more success than going it alone. Choose a workplace whose atmosphere is kind, because conflict drains you faster than hard work does.
life.career.2.child: Your child learns best in a calm, encouraging setting with a patient teacher. Art, music, stories and group work suit them. They notice moods closely, so harsh criticism sets them back more than it would another child. Gentle routines and steady praise build both skill and confidence.

life.career.3.text: Your path points to teaching, advice and expression: education, law, finance, writing, speaking, consulting and anything that shares knowledge. Jupiter favours roles where you guide others and keep learning yourself. Recognition often comes through qualifications and a good name. Aim for work with room to grow, because a fixed routine with nothing new to master leaves you restless.
life.career.3.child: Your child learns quickly through talking, reading and asking questions. Languages, debate, drama and any subject with a good story behind it suit them. Give them a chance to explain what they have learnt, because teaching others is how they learn best. Encourage finishing work, not only starting it.

life.career.4.text: Your path points to technology, engineering, research, systems and reform. Rahu favours original thinking and work that changes how things are done, from software and data to law and social causes. You do well where method matters and shortcuts are punished. Careful, practical progress pays off, but sudden changes in employers or fields are common, so keep your skills current.
life.career.4.child: Your child learns best with hands-on projects, clear steps and room to take things apart. Science, maths, coding and building kits suit them. They may question rules, so explain the reason behind each one. A tidy, predictable routine helps them focus, and praise for careful work goes further than praise for speed.

life.career.5.text: Your path points to communication, trade and movement: sales, media, travel, marketing, commerce and any work with variety. Mercury favours quick thinking, networking and deals. You thrive where every day brings new people and problems. Avoid roles that tie you to one desk and one task for years; several income streams or a portfolio career often suit you better.
life.career.5.child: Your child learns fast and gets bored fast. Short, varied lessons, games, puzzles and activities that involve movement hold their attention. Languages and maths often come easily. Help them build the habit of finishing one thing before starting the next, and reward follow-through as much as quick answers.

life.career.6.text: Your path points to beauty, comfort and service: design, arts, hospitality, healthcare, teaching, luxury goods and family businesses. Venus favours work that makes life pleasant for others. You do well where quality and taste are valued and relationships with clients last. A harmonious workplace matters to you; you work hardest for people you respect.
life.career.6.child: Your child learns best through art, music and caring roles. They enjoy helping others and respond to warmth and appreciation. Group projects, performance and creative subjects suit them. They can take on too much to please people, so teach them that saying no politely is allowed.

life.career.7.text: Your path points to research, analysis and the inner life: science, investigation, technology, spirituality, healing, writing and specialist expertise. Ketu favours depth over display. You do best when given time to think and work alone. Recognition comes from being the person who knows, not the loudest in the room. Choose work that rewards accuracy and insight.
life.career.7.child: Your child learns best through quiet study, reading and exploring a subject deeply. They may prefer a few close friends and need time alone to recharge. Science, nature and research projects suit them. Do not mistake quietness for lack of interest; ask about their ideas and they will often surprise you.

life.career.8.text: Your path points to responsibility and long-term building: management, law, finance, property, manufacturing, mining and government. Saturn rewards patience, discipline and endurance. Success may come later than for others, but it lasts. You do well in structures with clear rules and steady promotion. Avoid get-rich-quick schemes; your fortune is built slowly and kept.
life.career.8.child: Your child learns best with structure, clear expectations and steady practice. They may be serious for their age and take setbacks hard. Reward persistence rather than only results. Subjects with long-term progress, such as music practice, maths or a sport, teach them that effort adds up.

life.career.9.text: Your path points to action and courage: the armed forces, police, surgery, engineering, sport, property and any field that needs energy and protection of others. Mars favours bold, decisive work. You do well where there is a clear mission and something to overcome. Leadership in difficult situations suits you; routine without challenge does not.
life.career.9.child: Your child learns best through activity, sport and competition. They have plenty of energy and need an outlet for it every day. Clear rules and a coach or teacher they respect bring out their best. Teach patience with others, and channel the competitive streak into games and goals.

life.work_style.1.text: You work best when you own the task from start to finish. You decide quickly and act on your own judgement, which makes you valuable in a crisis. The risk is impatience with slower colleagues and reluctance to ask for help. Set clear goals, delegate the details, and you get the most out of yourself and others.
life.work_style.1.child: In class your child wants to lead and to be first. Give them a role, such as monitor or team leader, so the energy has a place to go. They dislike being told what to do without a reason, so explain the purpose of each task.

life.work_style.2.text: You work best in a team, with a partner you trust and a clear sense of what others need. You are careful, considerate and good at smoothing problems before they grow. The risk is hesitating too long and taking criticism to heart. Agree decisions with one trusted person, then act on them.
life.work_style.2.child: In class your child works best next to a friend and under a kind teacher. They may hold back from answering until they are sure. Encourage them to speak up, and praise their care and neat work.

life.work_style.3.text: You work best when you can plan, explain and inspire. You are good at seeing the bigger picture and bringing people along with an idea. The risk is spreading yourself across too many projects. Choose two or three priorities at a time and finish them before taking on more.
life.work_style.3.child: In class your child enjoys explaining, discussing and performing. They may chat more than they write. Give them chances to present, and use checklists to help them finish written work.

life.work_style.4.text: You work best with a method: clear steps, good tools and time to do things properly. You are reliable, practical and good at fixing what others have broken. The risk is getting stuck on details or resisting change for too long. Build in regular reviews so your system keeps up with the world.
life.work_style.4.child: In class your child likes order and clear instructions. They may resist sudden changes in routine. Give warning before changes, and let them understand how things work rather than just memorising them.

life.work_style.5.text: You work best with variety, movement and people. You learn new skills quickly, adapt easily and are good with clients. The risk is losing interest once a task becomes routine. Break long work into short stages, change your setting now and then, and keep a written list of what you have promised.
life.work_style.5.child: In class your child is quick and curious but restless. Short tasks, movement breaks and hands-on activities help. Teach them to check their work before handing it in, since speed can bring careless mistakes.

life.work_style.6.text: You work best in a pleasant, orderly setting with people you like. You take pride in quality, notice what others need and are often the one who keeps a team together. The risk is taking on others' work to keep the peace. Agree clear responsibilities, and protect time for your own tasks.
life.work_style.6.child: In class your child likes a tidy desk, a kind teacher and helping others. They may avoid conflict at the cost of their own needs. Encourage them to ask for what they need, and praise good effort as well as good results.

life.work_style.7.text: You work best alone or in a small, quiet team, with time to think deeply. You notice what others miss and do excellent work when trusted. The risk is withdrawing when things go wrong and not sharing your ideas. Write down your thinking and share it early, so others can see its value.
life.work_style.7.child: In class your child may be quiet but thinks deeply. Large noisy groups tire them. Give them time to think before answering, and projects they can explore on their own.

life.work_style.8.text: You work best with clear rules, long-term goals and steady effort. You are disciplined, dependable and able to carry heavy responsibility. The risk is working too hard for too little recognition and becoming rigid. Ask for what your work is worth, and allow yourself rest as part of the plan.
life.work_style.8.child: In class your child is serious and conscientious. They may worry about getting things wrong. Help them see mistakes as part of learning, and celebrate steady progress.

life.work_style.9.text: You work best with a clear target and something to overcome. You bring energy, courage and drive, and you protect your team. The risk is impatience, anger when blocked and taking on battles that are not yours. Pause before reacting, and save your fire for the goals that matter most.
life.work_style.9.child: In class your child has lots of energy and a strong sense of fairness. They may clash with others when they feel something is unjust. Give them physical activity every day and help them put their feelings into words.

life.money.1.text: Money comes to you through position, initiative and your own ventures. You earn best when you are in charge of the result. Invest first in your own skills and business, but keep a reserve, because confidence can lead to large bets. Big purchases are best made after a night's sleep.
life.money.1.child: Trust your child with a small allowance to manage on their own. Let them make choices and learn from them. A savings goal they choose themselves motivates them more than rules.

life.money.2.text: Money comes to you through partnership, service and steady work. Your income often rises and falls like the tide, so a regular saving habit matters more for you than for most. Joint ventures with someone you trust do well. Avoid lending money from sympathy when you cannot afford to lose it.
life.money.2.child: Your child may spend to please others. Teach them to save a little from every gift, and show them the money growing in a jar or account.

life.money.3.text: Money comes to you through knowledge, advice and your reputation. Fees, teaching, consulting and finance suit you. You can be generous to a fault, so keep a budget and a clear line between giving and lending. Long-term investments made with good advice serve you well.
life.money.3.child: Your child may be generous and easily persuaded to spend. Talk about money openly, and let them plan a small purchase with a budget.

life.money.4.text: Money comes to you through careful, practical work and technical skill. Income can change suddenly, through new jobs or new fields, so an emergency fund is essential. Avoid speculation and schemes that promise fast returns. Steady saving and property often serve you better than shares you do not understand.
life.money.4.child: Your child does well with a simple system: a jar for saving, a jar for spending. Explain why prices change, and keep the rules consistent.

life.money.5.text: Money comes to you through trade, communication and many small streams. You earn quickly and can spend just as quickly. Automatic savings, set up when money comes in, protect you from yourself. Several income sources suit you better than one, but keep records, because details slip.
life.money.5.child: Your child may spend as fast as they receive. Teach them to wait a day before buying anything they did not plan, and praise them when they do.

life.money.6.text: Money comes to you through quality work, comfort and beauty, and often through family. You enjoy spending on your home, gifts and good things. A budget that includes some pleasure is easier for you to keep than a strict one. Property and family businesses often do well for you.
life.money.6.child: Your child likes buying gifts and nice things. Let them save towards something special, and show them how waiting makes the reward sweeter.

life.money.7.text: Money comes to you through expertise, research and specialist knowledge. You are not driven by money, which can mean undercharging. Set your fees by the value you bring, not by how comfortable you feel asking. Simple, long-term investments suit you better than active trading.
life.money.7.child: Your child may not care much about money. Teach the basics anyway: saving, value for money and how earning works.

life.money.8.text: Money comes to you slowly and steadily, through responsibility, management and long-term building. Saturn rewards patience: property, pensions and businesses built over years. Losses come from impatience or from carrying others' debts. Your later years are often more secure than your early ones.
life.money.8.child: Your child may be a natural saver. Encourage it, but also show them that money can be used well, for experiences and for others.

life.money.9.text: Money comes to you through energy, courage and action: you earn by doing. You can spend on impulse or to help others in need. Keep a reserve for emergencies, and avoid risky deals made in a hurry. Property and land often suit you.
life.money.9.child: Your child may spend on impulse. Give them a goal to save towards, and let them earn some money through tasks, so they feel the effort it takes.

life.love.1.text: In love you are loyal, protective and generous, and you like to take the lead. You need a partner who respects your independence and has a life of their own. Your challenge is to listen as much as you direct. Shared goals keep the relationship strong; small daily appreciation keeps it warm.
life.love.1.child: With friends your child is a natural leader. Teach sharing and turn-taking, and praise them when they let others lead.

life.love.2.text: In love you are tender, devoted and deeply attuned to your partner's moods. You need reassurance, kindness and a calm home. Your challenge is to say what you need instead of hoping it will be noticed. A partner who is steady and gentle brings out your best.
life.love.2.child: Your child forms close bonds and feels hurt easily. Help them name their feelings, and teach them that one unkind word does not end a friendship.

life.love.3.text: In love you are warm, sociable and generous, and you want a partner who is also a friend. Good conversation and shared beliefs matter to you. Your challenge is to give your partner time as well as advice. Learning, travel or a cause shared together keep the bond fresh.
life.love.3.child: Your child makes friends easily and loves to talk. Teach them to listen as well as to tell stories.

life.love.4.text: In love you are steady, honest and practical, and you show care through what you do. You need trust and a partner who accepts your unusual side. Your challenge is to express feelings in words, not only in deeds. Sudden changes in relationships are possible, so keep talking through difficult times.
life.love.4.child: Your child may have a few loyal friends rather than many. They can be blunt; teach them that kind words matter as much as honest ones.

life.love.5.text: In love you are charming, lively and fun, and you need a partner who enjoys change and conversation. Routine can make you restless. Your challenge is to stay present when things become ordinary. Plan new experiences together, and keep your promises, so freedom does not turn into distance.
life.love.5.child: Your child has many friends and moves between groups easily. Teach them loyalty and keeping promises to friends.

life.love.6.text: In love you are devoted, affectionate and family-minded. Home, beauty and harmony matter deeply to you, and you give a great deal. Your challenge is not to sacrifice yourself to keep the peace. Choose a partner who gives back as much as you give, and speak up early when something hurts.
life.love.6.child: Your child is caring and loves to help. Teach them that their own wishes matter too, and that true friends do not take advantage.

life.love.7.text: In love you are deep, private and sincere. You need a partner who respects your need for quiet and understands without many words. Your challenge is to let someone in and share what you feel. Shared interests and calm time together bring you close.
life.love.7.child: Your child may prefer one or two close friends. Do not push them into large groups; help them deepen the friendships they choose.

life.love.8.text: In love you are serious, loyal and committed for the long term. You may be slow to open up but deeply faithful. Your challenge is to show warmth and not only responsibility. A patient partner who values stability suits you, and love grows stronger with the years.
life.love.8.child: Your child may seem reserved with new friends. Give them time, and help them join activities where friendships form over months.

life.love.9.text: In love you are passionate, protective and brave. You love intensely and defend those close to you. Your challenge is temper and impatience in disagreements. A partner who is calm and strong suits you; physical activity together and quick apologies keep things good.
life.love.9.child: Your child is a loyal friend who stands up for others. Teach them to cool down before reacting, and to say sorry quickly.

blocks.life.family.1: In the family you are often the one who takes charge and protects its standing. Relatives may turn to you for decisions. Make room for others' opinions, especially those of your partner and children, so leadership feels like support rather than control.
blocks.life.family.2: In the family you are the peacemaker who holds everyone together. You remember birthdays, notice tensions and smooth them over. Make sure your own needs are heard too, and let others carry some of the emotional load.
blocks.life.family.3: In the family you are the adviser and teacher. Children and younger relatives learn a great deal from you. Family gatherings, traditions and shared learning matter to you. Balance guidance with listening, so advice is welcomed rather than resisted.
blocks.life.family.4: In the family you are the dependable one who fixes problems and keeps things running. You may carry practical duties for parents or siblings. Family life can see sudden changes, such as moves or new arrangements; steady routines help everyone through them.
blocks.life.family.5: In the family you bring energy, news and fun. You may live far from relatives or travel often, and you keep connections through calls and visits. Commit to regular family time, because others value your presence more than you may realise.
blocks.life.family.6: In the family you are the heart of the home. Duty to parents, partner and children comes naturally, and family often shapes your biggest decisions. Accept help in return, and keep some time that is yours alone.
blocks.life.family.7: In the family you may feel a little apart, the thoughtful one with different interests. Close bonds form with one or two relatives who understand you. Share your inner life with them, and keep up family traditions in your own way.
blocks.life.family.8: In the family you often carry responsibility early, perhaps for parents or younger siblings. You build security for the next generation. Let duty sit beside affection: say what you feel, not only what needs doing.
blocks.life.family.9: In the family you are protective and generous, the one who rushes to help in a crisis. Strong opinions can lead to clashes with relatives. Choose your battles, and let calm conversation settle disagreements.
blocks.life.health.1: Health tendencies: watch for overwork; regular rest and sunlight help.
blocks.life.health.2: Health tendencies: stress shows in digestion and sleep; calm routines help.
blocks.life.health.3: Health tendencies: moderation in rich food and regular walks help.
blocks.life.health.4: Health tendencies: nervous tension; fixed routines and fresh air help.
blocks.life.health.5: Health tendencies: restlessness; regular meals and breathing exercises help.
blocks.life.health.6: Health tendencies: watch sweets and comfort habits; gentle exercise helps.
blocks.life.health.7: Health tendencies: worry and irregular habits; meditation and nature walks help.
blocks.life.health.8: Health tendencies: joints and bones; stretching and rest days help.
blocks.life.health.9: Health tendencies: haste and over-exertion; warm-ups and calm help.

life.career_growth.1.text: Growth comes from taking charge early. Volunteer to lead projects, build a record of decisions that worked, and move toward roles where results carry your name. A mentor who has run something larger than you have is worth seeking out. Your thirties and forties often bring the biggest steps up.
life.career_growth.1.child: Support your child's learning by giving them small areas to run themselves: a reading list they choose, a club they help organise. Confidence built early carries into every subject.

life.career_growth.2.text: Growth comes through people. A strong working partnership, a trusted manager or a long-standing client often opens the next door. Build a reputation for reliability and tact. Formal training in counselling, teaching or care can turn your natural gifts into recognised skills.
life.career_growth.2.child: Support your child's learning with a steady study buddy or a patient tutor. Praise their care and neatness, and help them speak up in class.

life.career_growth.3.text: Growth comes through learning and sharing it. Each qualification, talk or published piece of work adds to your standing. Seek roles where you teach or advise, and keep a list of what you have achieved. Your reputation grows fastest when you finish what you start.
life.career_growth.3.child: Support your child's learning through reading together, debates at the dinner table and chances to present to the family. A good teacher can change everything for this child.

life.career_growth.4.text: Growth comes through skill and method. Certifications, technical depth and a reputation for solving hard problems open doors. Change can come suddenly; when it does, treat it as a chance to move into newer work rather than a setback.
life.career_growth.4.child: Support your child's learning with hands-on kits, clear timetables and explanations of why things work. Let them learn by building and testing.

life.career_growth.5.text: Growth comes through variety and contacts. A wide network, new skills and willingness to move bring opportunities. Short courses, travel and side projects keep you sharp. Choose employers who let you change roles inside the organisation rather than changing employers every year.
life.career_growth.5.child: Support your child's learning with variety: short sessions, games and real-world examples such as shopping maths or travel geography.

life.career_growth.6.text: Growth comes through quality and loyalty. Clients and employers who value your care tend to stay, and they recommend you. Investing in your craft, presentation and working environment pays off. A family business or partnership can become a lasting base.
life.career_growth.6.child: Support your child's learning with art, music and group projects. A warm, appreciative teacher brings out their best.

life.career_growth.7.text: Growth comes through depth. Become the specialist others consult, publish or present your findings, and seek roles that value accuracy over speed. Recognition may come later than for others, but it comes from real expertise and lasts.
life.career_growth.7.child: Support your child's learning with time to explore one subject deeply, a quiet place to study and adults who answer their questions seriously.

life.career_growth.8.text: Growth comes slowly and steadily. Stay with organisations long enough to rise, take on responsibility others avoid, and keep records of your results. Promotion often arrives after a long wait, and when it does, it is solid.
life.career_growth.8.child: Support your child's learning with steady routines and long-term goals, such as exams prepared for over months. Celebrate persistence.

life.career_growth.9.text: Growth comes through courage and results under pressure. Take on the difficult assignment, the turnaround or the crisis, and make your name there. Physical fitness and discipline support your career as much as skill does.
life.career_growth.9.child: Support your child's learning with sport, competition and clear goals. Physical activity before study helps them concentrate.

life.money_plan.1.text: A simple plan suits you: keep three months' expenses in reserve, invest in your skills or business, and make large decisions after sleeping on them. Review your money on the first day of each month.
life.money_plan.1.child: Give your child a small allowance and let them decide how to use it. Talk through one choice each month.

life.money_plan.2.text: A simple plan suits you: save a fixed amount the day income arrives, keep joint finances transparent, and never lend more than you could give away. Review together with your partner once a month.
life.money_plan.2.child: Start a savings jar with your child and add to it together each week.

life.money_plan.3.text: A simple plan suits you: set a monthly limit for gifts and treats, put the rest of surplus into long-term savings, and take advice before big investments. Spend on learning; it repays you.
life.money_plan.3.child: Let your child budget for a hobby, and talk about what they learnt from the purchase.

life.money_plan.4.text: A simple plan suits you: an emergency fund first, then steady saving into safe, understandable investments. Avoid tips and schemes. Keep paperwork in order, because details protect you.
life.money_plan.4.child: Use two jars, save and spend, and keep the rules the same every week.

life.money_plan.5.text: A simple plan suits you: automate saving, keep a simple record of spending on your phone, and wait a day before any unplanned purchase above a set amount. Spread income across several sources.
life.money_plan.5.child: Teach your child to wait a day before buying anything unplanned, and praise them when they do.

life.money_plan.6.text: A simple plan suits you: a budget that includes pleasures, savings for home and family goals, and clear limits on lending to relatives. Property is often a good long-term choice.
life.money_plan.6.child: Let your child save towards a gift for someone, and choose it themselves.

life.money_plan.7.text: A simple plan suits you: set your fees by value, put savings into simple long-term funds, and review once a quarter rather than watching every day. Ask a trusted adviser about what you are unsure of.
life.money_plan.7.child: Explain the basics of earning and saving, linked to what your child cares about.

life.money_plan.8.text: A simple plan suits you: long-term saving, property and pensions, built steadily. Avoid debts taken on for others. Your patience is your advantage; let compound growth do its work.
life.money_plan.8.child: Encourage your child's saving, and show them that money can also be used well for others.

life.money_plan.9.text: A simple plan suits you: a reserve for emergencies, a set amount for generosity, and a rule never to sign a deal on the day you are angry or excited. Land and property often suit you.
life.money_plan.9.child: Let your child earn towards a goal through effort, and save what they earn.

blocks.life.partner.1: You do best with a partner who respects your independence and has goals of their own, and who can share or warmly support your drive. Keep time for each other in a busy life, and let your partner lead sometimes. The compatibility add-on reads any partner's numbers against yours.
blocks.life.partner.2: You do best with a partner who offers steadiness, patience and open affection. Say what you need clearly, and choose someone who notices and responds. The compatibility add-on reads any partner's numbers against yours.
blocks.life.partner.3: You do best with a partner who is also a friend and shares your warmth and beliefs. Choose someone you can talk with for hours, and make learning or travel something you share. The compatibility add-on reads any partner's numbers against yours.
blocks.life.partner.4: You do best with a partner who values stability and accepts your independent mind. Honesty and practical support matter more to you than grand gestures. Talk through changes together, because surprises are hard on you. The compatibility add-on reads any partner's numbers against yours.
blocks.life.partner.5: You do best with a partner who enjoys variety and conversation and gives you room to move while staying close. Shared adventures keep the bond alive. The compatibility add-on reads any partner's numbers against yours.
blocks.life.partner.6: You do best with a partner who appreciates home, beauty and loyalty, and who gives as much care as they receive. Shared plans for home and family bring you close. The compatibility add-on reads any partner's numbers against yours.
blocks.life.partner.7: You do best with a partner who respects quiet and depth, and understands your need for time alone without taking it personally. Shared interests and calm evenings matter more than a busy social life. The compatibility add-on reads any partner's numbers against yours.
blocks.life.partner.8: You do best with a partner who is patient and values commitment. Love grows slowly for you and lasts. Show warmth openly, and choose a partner who shares long-term plans. The compatibility add-on reads any partner's numbers against yours.
blocks.life.partner.9: You do best with a partner who is strong but gentle, able to match your energy or calm it. Apologise quickly after disagreements, and share physical activities together. The compatibility add-on reads any partner's numbers against yours.
blocks.life.parent.1: As a parent you encourage independence and achievement. Children learn confidence from you. Remember to praise effort, not only results, and to let them make some of their own choices.
blocks.life.parent.2: As a parent you are gentle, attentive and protective. Children feel safe with you. Let them face small difficulties on their own, so they build resilience.
blocks.life.parent.3: As a parent you teach, encourage and share stories and values. Children learn a great deal from you. Listen as much as you guide, and let them form their own opinions.
blocks.life.parent.4: As a parent you provide structure, routine and practical help. Children know where they stand. Leave room for play and surprise, and explain the reasons behind rules.
blocks.life.parent.5: As a parent you bring fun, curiosity and new experiences. Children love your energy. Give them steady routines too, so that home feels secure.
blocks.life.parent.6: As a parent you are devoted and nurturing, often putting children first. Take care of yourself as well, and let children help with the home so they learn responsibility.
blocks.life.parent.7: As a parent you encourage thinking, questions and inner values. Children learn depth from you. Join in their activities too, so they feel your closeness as well as your wisdom.
blocks.life.parent.8: As a parent you teach discipline, responsibility and long-term thinking. Children learn to work hard. Show affection openly, and celebrate their small wins.
blocks.life.parent.9: As a parent you are protective and inspiring, teaching courage and fairness. Keep calm when children test limits, and model the patience you hope they will learn.
blocks.life.health_body.1: Traditional readings link 1 with the heart, eyes and circulation, and with energy that burns high and then drops. Watch for overwork, high blood pressure and eye strain. Morning sunlight, regular check-ups and real rest after big efforts help.
blocks.life.health_body.2: Traditional readings link 2 with digestion, fluids and sleep, and with health that follows mood. Watch for stomach upsets, water retention and sleep disturbed by worry. Regular meals, plenty of water and calm evenings help.
blocks.life.health_body.3: Traditional readings link 3 with the liver, weight and the nerves, and with health affected by indulgence. Watch for rich food, irregular hours and stress from overcommitment. Moderation, regular exercise and a set bedtime help.
blocks.life.health_body.4: Traditional readings link 4 with the nerves, sudden ailments and hard-to-diagnose complaints. Watch for stress building quietly and for accidents when rushed. A steady routine, time outdoors and early attention to small symptoms help.
blocks.life.health_body.5: Traditional readings link 5 with the nerves, skin and breathing, and with health affected by restlessness. Watch for burnout, irregular meals and too much screen time. Breathing exercises, walking and digital breaks help.
blocks.life.health_body.6: Traditional readings link 6 with the throat, kidneys and skin, and with comfort eating. Watch for sweets, rich food and taking on others' stress. Gentle exercise, fresh food and time in pleasant surroundings help.
blocks.life.health_body.7: Traditional readings link 7 with the nerves, digestion and immunity, and with health affected by worry and isolation. Watch for skipping meals while absorbed in work. Quiet time, good sleep and regular contact with people you trust help.
blocks.life.health_body.8: Traditional readings link 8 with the bones, joints, teeth and skin, and with complaints that build slowly. Watch for stiffness, long hours and neglecting check-ups. Stretching, warm food and steady routines help.
blocks.life.health_body.9: Traditional readings link 9 with the blood, muscles and heat in the body, and with injuries from haste. Watch for fevers, inflammation, cuts and strains. Regular exercise, cooling foods in hot weather and care when rushing help.
blocks.life.health_habits.1: Keep a fixed time for waking and sleeping. Exercise that you lead, such as running or a sport you organise, suits you. Leave work at work at least one day a week.
blocks.life.health_habits.2: Eat at regular times, and do not skip meals when upset. Swimming, walking by water and gentle yoga suit you. Keep evenings calm and screens off before sleep.
blocks.life.health_habits.3: Plan meals rather than eating on the go. Group exercise and walking with friends suit you. Limit late nights to keep your energy steady.
blocks.life.health_habits.4: Build a daily routine and keep it, even on holidays. Steady exercise such as walking, cycling or gym work suits you better than extremes. Slow down when driving or working with tools.
blocks.life.health_habits.5: Vary your exercise to stay interested: dance, sport, hiking. Set phone-free hours each day. Eat regular, simple meals rather than snacking.
blocks.life.health_habits.6: Make healthy food beautiful and enjoyable, so that it is easy to choose. Dance, gardening and walks suit you. Rest when you have cared for others all day.
blocks.life.health_habits.7: Keep regular mealtimes, especially when absorbed in study or work. Walks in nature, yoga and meditation suit you. Stay in touch with friends; isolation affects your health.
blocks.life.health_habits.8: Stretch every morning, and take regular breaks from sitting. Steady, long-term exercise suits you. Keep up dental and bone check-ups.
blocks.life.health_habits.9: Exercise every day, ideally something physical and demanding. Drink plenty of water and cool down after effort. Count to ten before reacting; anger affects your health.
blocks.life.health_mind.1: Your mind is strong and decisive, but pressure to succeed can build. Share responsibilities, and accept that rest is part of leadership.
blocks.life.health_mind.2: Your mind is sensitive and caring, and absorbs others' moods. Talk about worries early, and keep a few calm, trusted people close.
blocks.life.health_mind.3: Your mind is optimistic and busy. Too many commitments bring stress; a written list of priorities helps you feel in control.
blocks.life.health_mind.4: Your mind is analytical and can worry over details. Writing worries down and setting a time to deal with them helps.
blocks.life.health_mind.5: Your mind is quick and restless. Short meditations, breathing exercises and finishing one thing at a time help you feel settled.
blocks.life.health_mind.6: Your mind is caring and can feel responsible for everyone. Remind yourself that others' happiness is not yours to carry alone.
blocks.life.health_mind.7: Your mind is deep and reflective, and can turn inward too far. Balance solitude with company, and share what is on your mind.
blocks.life.health_mind.8: Your mind is serious and enduring, and can carry too much in silence. Let people help, and make room for enjoyment.
blocks.life.health_mind.9: Your mind is passionate and quick to react. Physical exercise and time to cool off before decisions keep you balanced.
